sql:
SELECT
  t.status,
  t.tests_count,
  ROUND(t.tests_count * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ab_tests), 1) AS share_of_tests_pct,
  t.tests_with_winner_declared_count,
  ROUND(t.avg_variants_per_test, 1) AS avg_variants_per_test,
  ROUND(t.avg_duration_days, 1) AS avg_duration_days
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.status,
    COUNT(*) AS tests_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.winner_variant_id IS NOT NULL) AS tests_with_winner_declared_count,
    AVG(vc.variant_count) AS avg_variants_per_test,
    AVG(CASE WHEN a.started_at IS NOT NULL AND a.ended_at IS NOT NULL
         THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.ended_at - a.started_at)) / 86400.0 END) AS avg_duration_days
  FROM ab_tests a
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ab_test_id, COUNT(*) AS variant_count
    FROM ab_variants
    GROUP BY ab_test_id
  ) vc ON vc.ab_test_id = a.id
  GROUP BY a.status
) t
ORDER BY t.tests_count DESC, t.status ASC
